faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open 5AM to 11PM Monday–Friday, 6AM to 10PM on weekends.

faqs.question: Do you have ladies-only classes?
faqs.answer: Yes — Ladies-only Zumba every Tuesday and Thursday at 7:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Free parking is available for members behind the building (entrance from Main Street).

faqs.question: Do you offer personal training?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer 1-on-1 personal training — starting from Rs. 3,000/session. Ask 'TRAINER' for details.

faqs.question: How can I cancel my membership?
faqs.answer: Send 'CANCEL' and we will send the cancellation form. Please note the cancellation policy in membership details.
